filters.basis: The table holds NGC 147, NGC 185 and NGC 205 (M110); these are the rows of NGC 205.

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the plane the picture stands on, facing the Sun (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: Globular clusters of M110 (NGC 205) whose spectra Sharina et al. (2006) measured: one dot per cluster at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
